name: Duco Ventilation
description: The Duco component controls a Duco ventilation system directly over a UART connection, without the Duco Connectivity Board. It uses the same protocol as the Connectivity Board.

config_entries.label: UART ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID of the [UART Component](https://esphome.io/components/uart/) if you want to use multiple UART buses.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID of the Duco component.

config_entries.label: Disable CRC
config_entries.description: Accept messages that fail the checksum check. Only for troubleshooting. Defaults to `false`.

config_entries.label: Discovery
config_entries.description: Discover the nodes connected to the box once after boot and list them with the configuration in the logs. Takes no options; use `discovery: {}`.

config_entries.label: Time
config_entries.description: Set the clock of the box from a [Time Component](https://esphome.io/components/time/).

config_entries.label: Update Interval
config_entries.description: How often the clock is set. Defaults to `15min`.

config_entries.label: Time ID
config_entries.description: The time source to use. Defaults to the only time source in the configuration.
